description: TO_JSON serialises the VARIANT VALUE. The engine carries VARIANT, ARRAY and OBJECT values as JSON text, so TO_JSON of a semi-structured value returns that JSON compacted and must NOT re-encode the text into a JSON string - ["a"], never the double-encoded form, which broke vendor assertions written as TO_JSON(array_col) = '["X"]'. A non-JSON string is a variant STRING and serialises quoted, including one whose text merely STARTS with a valid JSON number token: a lenient parser that ignored trailing tokens would truncate "2026-04-20 12:00:00" to 2026. A JSON null serialises as the four-character text null, which the suite pins by comparison and length rather than by reading the cell, since a SQL NULL renders the same way. Converted 1:1 from functions/ToJsonTest (now retired).

steps.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tj_arr WHERE TO_JSON(a) = '["LAPTOP_DESKTOP"]'
